bio: U Eat & Sleep is one of the hotspots of the buzzy Eilandje district thanks to a phenomenal view over the MAS and marina and a glammed-up interior oozing in vibrant sensuality. After kicking off your meal with knockout cocktails and tapas, we recommend the extensive menu which features playful, light dishes as well as big-boned brasserie classics. Whether you opt for a sole meunière or a vegetarian dish of aubergine, sesame and miso, you can rely on the establishment’s funky ethos: affordable luxury!...
